summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of the sale of the 168-room Lakeway Resort and Spa in Austin, Texas to Trestle Studio LLC for $37.75 million in cash, subject to customary prorations, netting approximately $37.2 million after expenses. The transaction closed on May 19, 2026, per a February 10, 2026 purchase agreement as amended March 18, 2026. The company also paid ~$36.3 million to the mortgage lender, whose loan was secured by 16 hotels including Lakeway. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Pro forma financials adjusted for the sale. Watch for debt reduction use of proceeds and potential additional asset sales by this lodging REIT.
